## Description

RELEASE records per item (visit summary, prescription, result, document) with who released and when; tenant defaults per type (e.g. normal results auto-release after review vs manual), never auto-release abnormal results without review. Unrelease (hide) with reason.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Nothing is visible in the portal without a release record; abnormal results cannot be auto-released.
- [ ] **AC2.** Release/unrelease is audited and reflected in the portal within 1 minute.
- [ ] **AC3.** Default policies are configurable and documented, reviewed by the clinical advisor.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
